items.title: Konitz Lee — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: As I say, it was Dave Berger and Sy Johnson. ... Dave Berger was responsible for that instrumentation. He had charts and it was his suggestion for that instrumentation.

ctx.x: In any case the band did begin and I guess Dave Berger had some charts.
Yeah. Dave Berger was responsible for that instrumentation. He had charts and it was his suggestion for that instrumentation.
But then you met Sy Johnson or you already knew Sy but Sy got interested in writing for the band.
